scripts.models: npm run models:donkey && npm run models:holy
scripts.models:donkey: gltf-transform metalrough models-src/donkey.glb models-src/_tmp-donkey-1.glb && gltf-transform webp models-src/_tmp-donkey-1.glb models-src/_tmp-donkey-2.glb && gltf-transform meshopt models-src/_tmp-donkey-2.glb public/models/donkey.glb --level medium
scripts.models:holy: gltf-transform join models-src/holy-family.glb models-src/_tmp-holy-1.glb && gltf-transform weld models-src/_tmp-holy-1.glb models-src/_tmp-holy-2.glb && gltf-transform simplify models-src/_tmp-holy-2.glb models-src/_tmp-holy-3.glb --ratio 0.07 --error 0.02 && gltf-transform meshopt models-src/_tmp-holy-3.glb public/models/holy-family.glb --level high
scripts.models:inspect: gltf-transform inspect public/models/donkey.glb && gltf-transform inspect public/models/holy-family.glb
